shell_commands_self_reported.command: find advisories repo -type f -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | head -200 && echo --- && ls -la reports 2>/dev/null

cat advisories/advisories.json && echo ---LATEST--- && cat advisories/latest-versions.json && echo ---POLICY--- && cat repo/update-policy.md && echo ---REQ--- && cat repo/ingest/requirements.txt && echo ---REQ2--- && cat repo/worker/requirements.txt && echo ---PKG--- && cat repo/web/package.json rep

grep -n -E '"(node_modules/)?(lodash|axios|minimist|express|chalk|jest|react)"' repo/web/package-lock.json repo/admin/package-lock.json | head -40 && grep -n -A1 -E '^\s*"(node_modules/)?(lodash|axios|minimist|express|chalk|jest|react)": \{' repo/web/package-lock.json repo/admin/package-lock.json |

grep -n -E 'node_modules/[^"]*/node_modules/(lodash|axios|minimist|express|chalk|jest|react|pyyaml)"' repo/web/package-lock.json repo/admin/package-lock.json; echo "exit=$?"; grep -c '"node_modules/' repo/web/package-lock.json repo/admin/package-lock.json; grep -n -E '"(lodash|axios|minimist)": \{'
